purpose: Depth-matched factorial failure analysis. All darkening/blur contrasts are computed inside fixed reference-depth bins so that every compared condition has identical pixels and identical reference-depth support. This removes the depth-distribution mismatch present in pooled cohort-level effects. No new physical data collected.
blur_definition: strong_blur: Gaussian sigma=5.0 model-input pixels after resize to 224x280 (see extension_protocol.json)
aggregation: Mean per frame within bin, then equal weight per object group, then equal weight over groups; seed effects averaged with sample SD. Frames without bin support excluded.
interpretation: Within-bin contrasts are pixel-paired across conditions. Cross-cohort comparison is meaningful only within the same bin and remains descriptive, not a causal identification.
selection: All frames, models, seeds and factors scored; no test-performance-based selection.
